$comment: Harness wiring map. Checked by scripts/harness-map.mjs check (CI); rendered by harness-map.mjs render. Add a node when you add a skill, hook, agent or script.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md (root)
nodes.summary: Universal standards: domain table, skills-are-the-workflow list, git, context, orchestration and security rules.
rules: More specific CLAUDE.md wins on conflict
No commit or push without explicit approval
All branch work happens in worktrees

nodes.label: web/CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, Radix+CVA, Vitest, Playwright, Vercel stack rules.
rules: Hand-load TESTING-TRAPS.md before interactive-UI test work

nodes.label: games/CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Godot 4, GDScript, GUT stack rules.
rules: Hand-load DIAGNOSTICS.md before movement/physics/feel work

nodes.label: apps/CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Expo (React Native), Tauri v2, Jest+RNTL, Maestro stack rules.
rules: TypeScript strict, no any or @ts-ignore

nodes.label: settings.json
nodes.summary: Wires every hook by event and matcher; session default model opus; teams on; OTel env.
rules: Denies git add -A / --all at the permission layer too

nodes.label: ROUTING.md
nodes.summary: Evidence-distilled table: which model and effort for which kind of dispatch.
rules: fable needs per-run FABLE OK
No haiku routing (user decision 2026-09-04)
Opus fails → one read-only fable diagnostic, then the user

nodes.label: spec
nodes.summary: Design doc for open-shape work; the user approves before planning.
rules: Lives in the GitHub issue body (## Goal / ## Done when / ## Out of scope)
Skipped when the shape is obvious

nodes.label: plan
nodes.summary: Plan mode; the issue body is the spec, commit bodies carry resume state.
rules: User approves the plan, then execution runs without per-change approval

nodes.label: worktree
nodes.summary: Branch cut into a worktree; main checkouts never leave main.

nodes.label: execute / dispatch
nodes.summary: Work done directly or dispatched to subagents, teammates or workflows.
rules: Pause only when done, blocked, or the plan needs revision

nodes.label: qa
nodes.summary: The domain's gate list at 100% before calling work done.
rules: UI waves get hands-on user QA before push/PR

nodes.label: land / PR
nodes.summary: Commit, push, PR, watch checks until green, rebase-merge.
rules: Rebase and merge, never squash
Zero check runs ≠ passing

nodes.label: reflect
nodes.summary: End-of-phase review with the user; lands agreed harness edits.
rules: User can decline

nodes.label: cleanup / continuation
nodes.summary: Workspace sweep, then a paste-ready resume prompt before /clear.
rules: Continuation is a prompt, never a file

nodes.label: plan
nodes.summary: Plan-mode conventions: issue-as-spec, commit-body cadence, five plan-time checks, design-fork debate.
rules: Spec first when the shape is open

nodes.label: worktree
nodes.summary: Creates and removes feature worktrees with env files copied.
rules: Main checkout never leaves main

nodes.label: agent-factory
nodes.summary: Spawn posture, dispatch template, lane choice and model routing.
rules: Raise your own thinking level before dispatching
Name an agent only when it must exchange results mid-task (teams)

nodes.label: qa
nodes.summary: Runs the repo's own gates via qa.mjs with honest exit codes.

nodes.label: git-ops
nodes.summary: Git conventions, the claude-config land lane, branch finishing, recovery, end-of-wave sweep (cleanup.mjs).
rules: Explicit paths always
Docs repo commits direct to master

nodes.label: reflect
nodes.summary: On PR merge or phase close: 3 evidence-cited questions over every window of the unit, then in-place harness edits.

nodes.label: continuation
nodes.summary: Paste-ready resume prompt for after /clear.
rules: Always asks clear-vs-continue first; never unprompted

nodes.label: harness-editing
nodes.summary: Layout map, live-vs-commit rule and verification discipline for harness edits.
rules: A rule that must always hold is a hook, not prose
Behavior claims are verified by probe

nodes.label: new-component
nodes.summary: Hard-gated TDD chain for Radix+CVA+Tailwind components.

nodes.label: new-repo
nodes.summary: 24-step hard-gated production repo scaffold.
rules: .gitignore is committed before anything else

nodes.label: release
nodes.summary: Hard-gated npm release: checks, build, dist verify, Storybook, semver, changeset.
rules: Nothing ships on a failing gate

nodes.label: visual-asset-gates
nodes.summary: Per-asset user gates for images, SVGs, palettes and screenshots.
rules: Two direction rejections in a row → stop and re-anchor

nodes.label: yak-voice
nodes.summary: Corpus-driven CarsickYak channel copy from accepted real samples.
rules: Few-shot from accepted copy only

nodes.label: fable-clearance-grant
nodes.summary: UserPromptSubmit: writes a single-use, 30-minute clearance marker when you type FABLE OK.
rules: A menu answer does not grant — it must be a typed message

nodes.label: agent-model-guard
nodes.summary: PreToolUse:Agent — fills model: sonnet when omitted (blocks on a billed/unknown session), resolves a fork's real model, spends clearance for fable/mythos.
rules: Fails closed
A rejected dispatch still spends the grant (accepted 2026-09-21)

nodes.label: pre-model-switch
nodes.summary: PreModelSwitch — a /model switch to fable spends the same clearance.
rules: Switching away from fable is always free

nodes.label: bash-guard
nodes.summary: PreToolUse:Bash|PowerShell — nine rules, incl. shell-launched fable (rule 7, added in C8), push/PR approval (rule 8, #75) and headed-Playwright browser consent (rule 9, #75).
rules: No git add -A / commit -a
No .env in git
No gate (by command word, incl. cargo/just) piped onward
No Set-Content/Out-File
No commit on main in code repos (each git call judged in its own cd'd repo)
claude-config main never switches branch or restores files
claude --model fable needs FABLE OK

git push / gh pr create / gh pr merge need an approving AskUserQuestion answer in the transcript, single-use per verb (a branch delete also accepts "delete"; a negator refuses only the act it negates)
Command substitutions (`…`, $(…), <(…)) are parsed as commands; single-quoted text stays literal
One gated verb per Bash call — a compound with two is blocked unspent
playwright --headed/--ui/codegen/show-report/open need browser consent; headless playwright test is ungated

nodes.label: browser-gate
nodes.summary: PreToolUse:mcp__claude-in-chrome__.* — a visible browser needs the user's AskUserQuestion consent, granted once per session (#75).
rules: Fails closed
tabs_context_mcp and list_connected_browsers are never gated
One approving answer grants the rest of the session

nodes.label: _hooklib
nodes.summary: Shared plumbing: payload parsing, block/allow, fail-open default, and (since C8) the one billed-model clearance check.
rules: Guards opt into failClosed

nodes.label: post-model-switch
nodes.summary: PostModelSwitch — records the live model per session.
rules: Fires on Claude Code's own switches too

nodes.label: context-gauge
nodes.summary: UserPromptSubmit — forces a checkpoint before silent auto-compact.
rules: Bands are fractions of the live window

nodes.label: session-start
nodes.summary: SessionStart — injects the skill index (skills/INDEX.md; skills are Read, not Skill-tool invoked, #64), lists open in-progress issues (#72) and post-compaction reminders.

nodes.label: stop-reflect-gate
nodes.summary: Stop — reminds once per merged PR (a successful gh pr merge in the transcript) to run reflect.
rules: Reminds, never hard-blocks (since 2026-08-21)
Once per merge: handled tool_use ids (newest 200) kept in ~/.claude/stop-reflect-gate.json

nodes.label: implementer
nodes.summary: One scoped task via strict TDD.
rules: Failing test first
opus override for 3+ file integration

nodes.label: reviewer
nodes.summary: Read-only spec-compliance and quality review.
rules: Never fixes, only reports

nodes.label: recon
nodes.summary: Read-only local and web fact-finding; also the fable diagnostic lane.
rules: No Write/Edit

nodes.label: opus
nodes.summary: Session default; reviewer; integration and high-stakes implementation.

nodes.label: sonnet
nodes.summary: Default for recon, scoped implementation and most dispatches.

nodes.label: fable
nodes.summary: Usage-billed. Reachable on plan quota (C7, 2026-09-21). Every path in needs FABLE OK.

nodes.label: haiku
nodes.summary: Not routed — effort is silently dropped on haiku (user decision 2026-09-04).

nodes.label: worktree.mjs
nodes.summary: Create, remove and list feature worktrees from origin's default branch.

nodes.label: qa.mjs
nodes.summary: Runs repo gates foreground and unpiped.

nodes.label: land.mjs
nodes.summary: claude-config commit lane: ephemeral worktree from origin/main, path-scoped diff.
rules: finish deletes a branch only when git cherry shows it merged
finish survives a locked worktree dir: warns and carries on

nodes.label: reflect-gather.mjs
nodes.summary: A unit's evidence via audit.mjs --session <name> plus per-repo git activity, in one payload.

nodes.label: cleanup.mjs
nodes.summary: End-of-wave sweep report; kill-port and remove-worktree options.

nodes.label: verify-frontmatter.mjs
nodes.summary: CI gate: every SKILL.md and agent def has parseable frontmatter, and resident bytes (unflagged descriptions + skills/INDEX.md + CLAUDE.md files) stay within CAPS (issues #63, #64).
rules: Caps live in one CAPS const at the top of the script
Bytes measured as UTF-8 with CRLF normalized to LF

nodes.label: lib.mjs
nodes.summary: Shared helpers for the workflow scripts; Node builtins only.

nodes.label: ~/code/docs
nodes.summary: Private repo: screenshots and the harness-evolution archive (read-only). Specs, checklists and issue logs retired to GitHub issues (#72).
rules: Commits direct to master with explicit paths
Pushed at wave close

nodes.label: fable-clearance.json
nodes.summary: The single-use FABLE OK marker. Valid 30 minutes; deleted by whichever gate spends it.

nodes.label: fable-dispatch.log
nodes.summary: One ALLOW/BLOCK line per billed-act decision, from all three gates.

nodes.label: current-model.json
nodes.summary: Live model per session — how the guard knows what a fork really runs on.

nodes.label: harness-evolution/archive
nodes.summary: Incident history and rule history — cite it, don't reload it.

nodes.label: notification-toast
nodes.summary: Notification — Windows toast when Claude Code needs attention (WezTerm has no native one).

nodes.label: harness-map.mjs
nodes.summary: check: this map covers every skill, hook, agent and script, and every file exists. render: builds the diagram page.
rules: CI fails when a harness file is added or removed without a map entry

nodes.label: export-harness.ps1
nodes.summary: Zips the harness and workspace MDs for moving to another machine.

nodes.label: import-harness.ps1
nodes.summary: Restores the harness from that zip on a new Windows machine.

nodes.label: open-admin-shells.ps1
nodes.summary: Opens three elevated PowerShell windows.

nodes.label: harness-map.json
nodes.summary: This map. Read it before sweeping files; update it in the same change as any wiring change.

nodes.label: GitHub issues
nodes.summary: Tracking (#72): issue = spec (Goal / Done when / Out of scope); active work labelled in-progress; PRs carry Closes #N.

nodes.label: transcripts
nodes.summary: Claude Code session + subagent transcripts; kept cleanupPeriodDays.

nodes.label: audit.mjs
nodes.summary: Transcript-replay audit: $, context depth, per-agent-type cost, skill/doc invocations, hook blocks and timings, and time (active vs wall, model/tools/user split, agent and tool latency, retry cost), inline edits vs dispatches; grouped by /rename session name, --session filters to one unit.

nodes.label: audit-lib.mjs
nodes.summary: Pure accounting for audit.mjs: requestId dedupe, 5m/1h cache pricing, cost-state cross-check, custom-title session names, timestamp timelines for the time dimension.

nodes.label: push-gate-approvals.json
nodes.summary: Which push/PR verbs each AskUserQuestion approval (keyed by transcript record uuid) has already spent (#75). Self-trims to the newest 200 uuids. CLAUDE_PUSH_GATE_STATE overrides the path.

nodes.label: browser-gate-sessions.json
nodes.summary: Sessions (by session_id) the user has granted a visible browser (#75). Self-trims to the newest 200. CLAUDE_BROWSER_GATE_STATE overrides the path.

edges.label: no add -A, no commit on main, push/PR needs an approving answer
rule 8: spends the approval per verb
